title: record:quick_actions shows the authoring placeholder 「record:quick_actions — no actions configured」 to a customer when its configured actions are all withheld by the capability gate
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#3036 dev report (cloud PR #3040, report `6255576645`), out-of-scope finding 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What a user sees (measured)

The block was measured on a local stack at objectui `43efd078`, Chromium, zh-CN, on cloud's environment page, 「设置」 tab. The environment's admin-only actions declare `requiredPermissions: ['manage_org_users']`, and a plain member does not hold that capability.

In the member's view, the `record:quick_actions` blocks whose actions are all withheld draw the authoring text 「record:quick_actions — no actions configured」. The sentence is false, since the block names configured actions, and it is developer copy shown to a customer.

## Why (objectui `43efd078`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx:301` resolves the block's actions through `getActionsForLocation`.
- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionEngine.ts:231-241` drops every action whose `requiredPermissions` the viewer does not hold. That is correct.
- `record-quick-actions.tsx:309-319` then draws the placeholder whenever the resolved list is empty, whether the block named no action (an authoring slip) or named actions the viewer may not invoke.

## Target

- **Named actions, all withheld:** a block that names actions draws nothing, as the header and the row menu do.
- **No action named:** the placeholder stays only for a block that names no action, and in authoring and preview contexts only, never in a published page's runtime view.

## Acceptance

A test covers three cases:
- a block naming two actions, both withheld by `requiredPermissions`, renders nothing;
- a block naming none renders the placeholder in the authoring context only;
- a block with one held action renders that action.

## Note for the cloud consumer

Cloud's own page also hides a 「设置」 row whose actions are all withheld (cloud#3036's fix round). So this card is about every other page that reaches the state, not only cloud's.

## Dedupe

Searched for: `quick_actions no actions configured placeholder`, `capability withheld placeholder`, `authoring placeholder customer`.
